content:
As of 2024, the estimated population of the United States is approximately **334 million** people. According to the U.S. Census Bureau’s latest official estimate (as of July 1, 2023), the population was **334,233,854**, and it continues to grow slowly—primarily through natural increase (births minus deaths) and international migration.

For the most current and authoritative data, you can refer to the U.S. Census Bureau’s Population Clock or official estimates: [census.gov/popclock](https://www.census.gov/popclock).
